checks.name: Opening the application does not invent progress or create an accepted workspace
Explicit initialization and saving distinguish draft input from accepted data
Invalid completion evidence retains the practice form and leaves accepted storage unchanged
A valid practice project is persisted only after the workspace save and survives reload
Project editing increments its version and navigation guards retain an unfinished form
Search and status filtering paginate the actual project set
Confirmed deletion removes only the chosen project after saving the workspace
Archive filtering works while later practice missions remain gated
Written self-review records progress while repeat completion awards no duplicate XP
Two-tab conflict retains and exports the losing draft before explicit current-data recovery
A real transaction abort after put success preserves accepted data and the draft
Malformed imports are rejected without replacing the accepted workspace
Reviewed replacement snapshots accepted data and rejects an obsolete workspace identity
Recovery snapshot download preserves the stored recovery document
Practice forms remain usable at desktop, tablet and phone widths
Reviewed legacy migration preserves exact original text in place and in a snapshot
Malformed legacy data is retained and never auto-reset
Corrupt active data remains exportable and is never replaced by an empty workspace
Final reload preserves accepted projects and no uncaught application errors occurred
